en.headline: 17-month-old girl in critical condition with influenza A, pneumonia and septic shock
en.dek: The Centre for Health Protection reported another severe paediatric case; the previously healthy toddler remains in intensive care at Queen Elizabeth Hospital.
body: The Centre for Health Protection is investigating a further severe paediatric influenza case involving a 17-month-old girl who is in critical condition. She developed fever and cough on Sunday and sought private medical care on Monday before her condition deteriorated with shortness of breath.

She was taken to the accident and emergency department of Queen Elizabeth Hospital, where low blood pressure and breathing difficulty led to admission to the paediatric intensive care unit. Laboratory tests confirmed influenza A; the clinical diagnosis is influenza A complicated by severe pneumonia and septic shock.

Preliminary investigation found she had not received the 2025/26 seasonal influenza vaccine. Household contacts have so far shown no symptoms. The centre said that since late June nine severe paediatric influenza cases have been recorded, including one death, with several children still in serious or critical condition. Influenza activity remains high and the public is urged to maintain good personal and environmental hygiene.

zh.headline: 17個月大女嬰染甲流併發嚴重肺炎及敗血性休克 情況危殆
zh.dek: 衞生防護中心公布再有兒童甲型流感嚴重個案，女嬰過往健康良好，現於伊利沙伯醫院兒童深切治療部留醫，情況危殆。
body: 衞生署衞生防護中心今日公布再錄得一宗兒童感染甲型流感的嚴重個案，涉及一名過往健康良好的17個月大女嬰。她於周日起出現發燒及咳嗽，周一被帶到私家診所求醫，其後情况轉差並出現氣促，被送往伊利沙伯醫院急症室。
女嬰因呼吸困難及血壓偏低，獲安排入住該院兒童深切治療部。呼吸道樣本化驗證實對甲型流感病毒呈陽性，臨床診斷為甲型流感併發嚴重肺炎及敗血性休克，目前情况危殆。
初步調查顯示女童未接種2025/26年度季節性流感疫苗，家居接觸者暫時沒有病徵。中心總監徐樂堅表示，自6月底進入流感季節以來累計錄得九宗兒童嚴重個案，包括一宗死亡，另有兒童情况仍然嚴重或危殆。流感活躍程度維持高水平，呼籲市民保持良好個人及環境衞生。
